## About
Gordie Rosenberg has been working on Mercedes since the mid seventies. The shop is fully equipped with special tools for the classics and the modern cars, AMG cars included.
Gordie doesn't use cheap generic parts or fluids on your German automobile. Your Benz needs specific fluids you won't find at the quick oil change places and chain stores. And there are no fake specials to get you in the door and sell you service you don't need.
Customers have given the shop a 4.8 rating from 71 Google reviews. Regular maintenance is the key to keeping your Benz running smoothly, and Gordie is glad to help you stay on top of it.

## Services
- Service A: Mercedes-Benz synthetic motor oil and oil filter replacement, fluid level checks, tire inflation check, brake component inspection and maintenance counter reset.
- Service B: Everything in a basic service plus a cabin filter replacement and brake fluid exchange, at 20,000 mile intervals.
- 30,000/60,000/90,000 Mile Maintenance: Automatic transmission fluid and filter change, air filter, spark plugs, propeller shaft flex coupling and parking brake inspection, and a road test.
- Wheel Balance & Road-Force Balance: Available with your maintenance service if you choose it.
- Free computer scans: Bring in that warning light and Gordie will look it over with you to see the problem.
- Free A/C checks: Have your air conditioning checked at no charge.

## FAQ
Q: How often should I change my oil?
A: Gordie recommends every 5,000-7,000 miles, always with full synthetic. He strongly advises against waiting for the longer factory interval. Oil is cheaper than metal.

Q: Can I just stop by?
A: Please call or text first. The shop works by appointment, and Gordie wants to make sure he's there and not too busy.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: Right now the shop accepts only cash and PayPal.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: In Pinellas Park, in the center grey building, second to last shop.
